messages:
leigh: Quick request — need a small rerun for the launch webinar. Need p50/p95 + cost delta fp16 vs quant8, and coldstart penalty separated. Manifest: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/cohort_B/manifest.csv

sam: Got it. Which model, sequence lengths, concurrency targets, and do you want embedding latency included?

leigh: Model: redwood/open-4b. Seq lengths: 2048 primary, include 4096 tail. Concurrency: 1 (interactive) and 8. Warmups: 5. Yes include token-cost-per-1k and coldstart numbers separately.

sam: Use this command and drop artifacts under the path below:
```
./bench/run_infer.sh --model redwood/open-4b \ 
  --variants fp16,quant8 \ 
  --cohort s3://redwood-marketing/launch/cohort_B/manifest.csv \ 
  --concurrency 1,8 --seq 2048,4096 --warmups 5 \ 
  --collect-traces true \ 
  --artifact-path s3://redwood-marketing/bench/results/1755554322/
```

izzy: If fp8 is available include it; otherwise add int8 fallback. Also record sampling params (top_k/top_p) per run.

runtime-bot: bench-runner scheduled job id=br-175555 triggered by @sam

sam: Running sweep now. Will post progress. ETA ~30m.

sam: Done. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/results/1755554322/summary.json and CSVs. Quick summary for slides:
- fp16 | seq=2048 | conc=1 | p50=49ms | p95=130ms | cost=$0.0021 per token-equiv
- quant8 | seq=2048 | conc=1 | p50=55ms | p95=172ms | cost=-20% vs fp16
Notes: quant8 reduces cost materially but shows higher tail on 4096; warmups reduce coldstart impact. Uploaded slide_table_1755554322.csv and a sample coldstart trace.

leigh: Awesome — exactly what we need for speaker prep. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
